agent.finish_summary: Fixed get_real_name() in sqlparse/sql.py (NameAliasMixin) so that for multi-part dotted names (e.g. 'db.schema.tbl.col') it returns the name after the LAST dot ('col') instead of after the first dot ('schema'). get_name() inherits this fix automatically since it calls get_real_name(). get_parent_name() was left unchanged and still correctly returns the part before the first dot ('db'). Verified manually: db.schema.tbl.col -> real_name='col', name='col', parent_name='db'; a.b -> 'b' (unchanged behavior); 'x.y.z AS w' -> real_name='z', alias='w'; 'mydb.sch.func(1)' -> real_name='func'.
